name: What interior maintenance is required after severe Colorado storms?

mainEntity.name: What interior maintenance is required after severe Colorado storms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Following severe wind, hail, or heavy snow events in the Denver area, interior maintenance primarily addresses leaks that have penetrated the building envelope. Common post-storm repairs include cutting away water-soaked sheetrock, treating framing, and reinstalling fresh drywall and insulation before mold can develop. Contractors also inspect ceilings, attic access points, and exterior-facing walls for hidden moisture staining, restoring interior paint and trim once structural drying is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Post-storm maintenance involves removing water-damaged drywall, drying framing, replacing insulation, and repairing interior trim and paint to prevent structural deterioration.
